name: Downtown Printing Center
what_they_do: Independent print shop on Paterson Street doing digital and offset printing (business cards, letterheads, brochures, manuals, raised printing), screen printing on apparel, and signs and banners, plus binding, Western Union, passport photos and engineering prints. The logo advertises 'over 40 years' and 'since 1977'.
customers: Local businesses, Rutgers-area offices and students, event and wedding customers, and walk-ins needing signs, apparel or passport photos.

size_signals.signal: 'Since 1977' and 'over 40 years' in the logo; four service families (digital, offset, screen, signs)
Two phone numbers listed (T: 732-246-7990, F: 732-246-3425); store hours 8:30-17:30
Offers Western Union and passport photos - a walk-in retail counter, not just B2B

website_review.primary_cta: none - no call, quote or order button on the home page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: contact form only (Name / Email / Message) on /contact; no quote fields, no file upload, no online ordering
website_review.trust_signals: 40+ years / since 1977 in the logo and one stock press photo; no real work samples, staff or reviews on the site
website_review.out_of_date_signs: copyright '© 2022' on every page; no meta description; the home page is a logo image plus one stock photo with almost no body text; services are communicated through the logo graphic rather than copy
website_review.search_basics: home title is just 'Downtown Printing Center' with no meta description and no h1; services are a flat bullet list on one page with no individual service pages (nothing for business cards, banners or screen printing); 'Services' page title names neither the service nor the town; LocalBusiness JSON-LD is present, the only local schema in this batch
top_issues: Home page never states services, address, phone or hours as text - just a logo and a stock press photo
No meta description, no h1, page titles like 'Services' carry no keywords
No individual service pages across four product families
No quote request with specs or artwork upload; customers email blind
Copyright 2022 and a GoDaddy builder imply an unmaintained site
3.8 stars - inconsistent service experiences in reviews

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is only 'User-agent: *' with no rules, so nothing blocks AI crawlers or Googlebot. LocalBusiness JSON-LD exists but is not backed by readable page content: the home page carries no service, price or address text. Address, phone and hours are readable on /contact. Booking: a reCAPTCHA-protected Name/Email/Message form with no quote fields, upload, quantity or turnaround capture - an agent cannot get a real estimate.

operations_signals.signal: Only intake routes are a free-text message form or a phone call; no way to send artwork, quantity or deadline - inference: staff re-key specs on every job
Reviews describe fast rush printing but also unfriendly service (3.8 average) - inference: counter and phone workload is straining responsiveness
Four production lines plus Western Union and passport-photo walk-ins - many interrupt-driven tasks at one counter

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the site around a real print quote/order intake: per-product pages (business cards, banners, apparel, signs) with size, quantity, turnaround and artwork upload
top_opportunities.evidence: Home page has no service text; the only form is Name/Email/Message with no specs, and services are one flat list.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Search basics rescue: meta descriptions, real h1s, town plus service page titles, one page per product family
top_opportunities.evidence: Title is just 'Downtown Printing Center' with no description or h1; 'Services' page title names neither the service nor New Brunswick.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-desk AI agent that reads incoming email and form requests, prices repeat jobs and drafts replies for staff approval
top_opportunities.evidence: Every job starts as free text or a phone call, and reviews point to uneven responsiveness.

scores.reasons: Gap 5: the website does not sell - no offer text, no quote path, 2022 copyright. Ability 3: 40-year-old shop with four product lines and a retail counter, so budget exists but is likely modest. Ease 4: a quote-first rebuild is well-trodden work. Evidence 5: every page observed directly.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The /contact page does contain tel: links for (732) 246-7990 (two of them); the real gap is the home page, which has no phone number, address or CTA as text at all.
